privacyPage.intro1: ExamSnap processes your photo and signature entirely on your device.
privacyPage.introStrong: Your images never leave your device
privacyPage.intro2: — there is no image upload and no image is ever sent to any server.
privacyPage.storeIntro: To learn which exams to add and verify next, and to catch wrong sizes, we store a small amount of non-image data when you process an unlisted exam or report an outcome:
privacyPage.store1: Exam names and the size/format numbers you entered
privacyPage.store2: Links to official notifications you choose to share
privacyPage.store3: Outcomes (whether a portal accepted or rejected a file) and short error text you type
privacyPage.store4: An anonymous ID (a random value in your browser), used only to count distinct submitters
privacyPage.store5: A one-way hashed form of your IP address, used only to rate-limit abuse
privacyPage.never1: Your images (photo, signature, thumb impression, declaration)
privacyPage.never2: Your name, email or any account details
privacyPage.never3: Your raw IP address or any device identifier
privacyPage.anonBody: The anonymous ID lives only in your browser and is not linked to you. You can reset it any time by clearing this site's data in your browser settings.
privacyPage.footnote: Please don't include personal details in the optional "portal error message" field when reporting a rejection.
